description: The file '/home/ga/Documents/JASP/BigFivePersonalityTraits.csv' is already open in JASP. This is a real NEO personality inventory dataset containing the Big Five personality trait scores for 231 participants. The five columns are: 'Neuroticism', 'Extraversion', 'Openness', 'Agreeableness', and 'Conscientiousness'. Click the 'Regression' tab in the top menu bar, then select 'Correlation' to open the Correlation panel. Add all five personality trait variables to the Variables box. Under Statistics, enable 'Report significance' and 'Flag significant correlations'. Under Plots, enable 'Heatmap'. Leave all other settings at their defaults.
